cases.description: Upset story with three sources that partly overlap

opportunity.title: Harbor City Gulls stun Northvale Rovers in the Fixture Premier Division
opportunity.description: The newly promoted Gulls beat the unbeaten league leaders away from home.
opportunity.why_now: Result came in last night; the leaders' unbeaten run is over.
opportunity.angle: How a promoted side with the smallest budget in the league planned the upset.
opportunity.hook: The cheapest squad in the league just ended the longest unbeaten run.

sources.title: Gulls end Rovers' unbeaten run with late winner
sources.summary: Harbor City Gulls won 2-1 at Northvale Rovers on 4 October. The winner came in the 88th minute. Rovers had been unbeaten in their first 11 league matches.

sources.title: Northvale coach Teodor Vask: 'We were second best tonight'
sources.summary: Vask said his side lacked intensity and praised the Gulls' pressing. He did not comment on the referee.

sources.title: Gulls were promoted with the league's lowest wage bill
sources.summary: A preseason report listed Harbor City Gulls with the lowest wage bill of the 18 Fixture Premier Division clubs.
